notes.title: New Animated Scene Previews and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[i]A wild update appears[/i]

We have added some new animated scene previews in the credits for you all to enjoy. 

In addition to this we have resolved some bug fixes in a couple of the locations regarding Cosmo and his clipping issues. We will be rolling out regular updates to other maps in future to resolve the issues in those too.

We hope you are enjoying the game :)

notes.title: Diary Page Fixes
notes.notes:
Latest patch has a fix for the Diary pages freeze issue as well as some Dialogue that did not trigger correctly. Some trigger and clipping issues resolved too in Sunken Ship and water town.

Thanks for playing

CryptidTech

notes.title: Fishing of Eradine!
notes.notes:
Fishing of Eradine (working title) is slowly but surely becoming its own standalone title, and soon becoming more and more advanced in the things it contains. 

I'm extremely proud of the hard work Felipe has done to make this mini-game the best fishing game in any RPG and it now even has its own shop!

From a Shards perspective, we will be including new doors that are now "open" for business, but we are loving it so much there is a high degree of likelihood it will become its own game for Android. We may even go so far as to include some form of account share so as you can sync up fish and items between mobile and PC titles too.

Short preview can be viewed here :

[url=http://shardsoferadine.com/videos/abba_final.wmv]

notes.title: Shards of Eradine New Game Plus update!
notes.notes: Shards of Eradine has been patched to now feature the New Game+ mode. Start again with a full boosted party and face more challenges as the enemies are tougher and more resolute in beating Cosmo and his friends
